plan.title: Disable View-Only Mode and Restore Counter Offer

steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for testing auction actions and counter offers.
Navigate to the auction stage where the Actions menu is available.
Select View-Only Mode once to exercise the same action.
Reopen the Actions menu after the first toggle.
Select the same action again to disable View-Only Mode.
Open the responses view where the counter-offer action is available.
Attempt the previously restricted counter-offer action.
Verify that the counter-offer interface opened after View-Only Mode was disabled.
